Chapter 706: Chapter 11 That ‘White Paper’ (Please Subscribe)

“How is it?”

“Our human civilization only wants one fifth of the aurora. That’s not excessive.”

The Ancient Power Supreme Being spoke in a calm tone, yet within this twisted spacetime, the breaths of eight other Supreme Beings were unmistakably unmasked.

The other ten or more Supreme Beings glanced at each other.

There were also Ultimate Beings standing behind them, but the combat power of the nine Supreme Beings of human civilization was indeed difficult to deal with.

“Very well.”

...

The one-horned Supreme Being eventually compromised.

There was no choice.

If they didn’t first satiate human civilization, the subsequent division would be impossible to complete.

Search.

The Ancient Power Supreme Being raised his hand and took one fifth of the aurora. He then vanished from this spacetime.

As soon as the Ancient Power Supreme Being left, the breaths of the eight human civilization Supreme Beings also rapidly receded.

“My Tianyu Clan has also suffered heavy losses…” began the Clan Tianyu Progenitor slowly, wanting to replicate the recent actions of human civilization and take a portion of the aurora first.

…

Human Civilization Territory.

The nine Supreme Beings were rapidly exchanging thoughts through their spirit wills.

“Within this aurora segment, there is a profound presence of the Causal Curse Killing power. Before it’s refined into the ultimate weapon, it could be utilized to let those talented Evolvers comprehend it for a while.”

“Indeed, the causal rules, though not pillar-level rules, are the most mysterious and special. The more one comprehends the causal rules, the better, with no downsides.”

“Then I will refine this segment of aurora first.”

…

The nine Supreme Beings quickly determined the use for the aurora.

It would be refined into the ultimate weapon.

But before refining, they could allow some talented successors of human civilization to closely sense the essence of the aurora.

…

Xia Qin Supreme Being’s personal world.

Xia Qin Supreme Being sat high on the throne, seemingly deep in thought.

Not much later.

The figure of Lin Yuan appeared.

“Supreme Being,” Lin Yuan bowed slightly.

The more he cultivated, the more Lin Yuan felt the greatness of the Supreme Beings.

This greatness wasn’t limited to strength; their life essence, their heights, were beyond what any life within the River of Time could look up to.

“Hmm,” Xia Qin Supreme Being looked at Lin Yuan and a smile appeared on his face, “How has your cultivation been lately? Have you encountered any bottlenecks?”

Xia Qin Supreme Being was very concerned about Lin Yuan, as in his eyes, Lin Yuan was the Evolver most likely to reach the ultimate in this era of human civilization.

If human civilization could birth the tenth Supreme Being, the pressure they bore would naturally lessen considerably.

“It’s going well.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

More than just well.

Fifty years ago, Lin Yuan had only comprehended two pillar-level fusion rules.

But now, Lin Yuan mastered up to six pillar-level fusion rules, among which the Life and Death Samsara Rule had even reached the Second Realm, and the Great Destruction Rule was also nearing the Second Realm.

Achievements unattainable by typical Tenth Rank Evolvers over millions of years, Lin Yuan had achieved in just fifty years.

Not to mention, beyond the fusion rules, Lin Yuan had made significant progress on Space Rules, the Rule of Time, and the Profound Yellow Lineage’s three Dao-Protecting Secret Techniques.

“Good to hear.”

Xia Qin Supreme Being did not probe further.

The path of evolution is a very private matter.

With Lin Yuan’s talents and aptitudes, he had already forged his own path.

If he intervened forcefully, it wouldn’t be beneficial.

What Xia Qin Supreme Being could do now was to resolve all of Lin Yuan’s potential worries as much as possible.

“In some time, there will be an opportunity to comprehend that segment of aurora essence. I will let you go,” Xia Qin Supreme Being said directly.

“The essence of the aurora?”

“Is it the aurora from the destruction of the Large Alien Battlefield marked A076?”

Lin Yuan’s eyes brightened, and he immediately asked.

“Exactly,” Xia Qin Supreme Being nodded.

There was no need to keep secrets about this matter.

“After negotiations with those Different Species Supreme Beings, our human civilization finally got one fifth of the entire aurora,” Xia Qin Supreme Being briefly explained.

“Negotiations?”

“One fifth?”

Lin Yuan blinked.

Among peak clans, power was always supreme, negotiations? What negotiation?

And one fifth? According to Lin Yuan’s knowledge, there were more than ten Supreme Beings involved in blocking the aurora initially.

That doesn’t yet count those who later wished to share in the spoils.

Directly taking one fifth for human civilization was utterly domineering.

“Supreme Being, where did this aurora come from?” Lin Yuan asked.

He knew that the aurora originated from beyond the Eternal Spatial Rift, that is, within the Chaos Void.

But exactly where, and why such an entity as the ‘aurora’ would form.

Lin Yuan was not very clear.

“This aurora, it likely comes from the ‘Taiyuan Relic,'” Xia Qin Supreme Being pondered for a moment before speaking.

“The Taiyuan Relic?” Lin Yuan was slightly stunned.

“Yes, currently within the detected scope of the Chaos Void, the Taiyuan Relic is ranked among the nine most dangerous places,” Xia Qin Supreme Being said.

Lin Yuan listened obediently.

The matters Xia Qin Supreme Being spoke of, clearly, were no longer confined to within the universe.

“Is the Taiyuan Relic very dangerous?” Lin Yuan noticed that the Xia Qin Supreme Being described the Taiyuan Relic as a ‘perilous place’.”

“Naturally, it’s extremely dangerous,” the Xia Qin Supreme Being nodded.

“Even for a Twelfth-Rank Life, a moment of carelessness can lead to complete ruin within the Taiyuan Relic,” the Xia Qin Supreme Being explained.

Moreover, the dangers of the Taiyuan Relic are not limited to within the relic itself, but occasionally also involve the forbidden items that erupt from its depths.

These forbidden items vary in influence, some strong and some weak, immeasurable in their impact.

“In the universe, a Twelfth-Rank Life is invincible, at most severely wounded,” the Xia Qin Supreme Being said with a sigh, “but outside the universe, in the Chaos Void, even a Twelfth-Rank Life can face death.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

A couple of hundred years ago, that corpse of a Supreme Being that drifted in from beyond the universe made Lin Yuan realize that even Supreme Beings can die.

A Supreme Being merely steps out of the River of Time and is not bound by lifespan, but that does not mean they cannot die.

“Of course, the Chaos Void is dangerous, but it also holds opportunities. We, as Twelfth Rank, wish to evolve further, to transform into a Perfect Time Being; such a chance exists only in the Chaos Void, albeit very slight,” the Xia Qin Supreme Being continued.

“Perfect Time Being?” Lin Yuan’s thoughts expanded.

A Ninth-Rank Life is also known as a Multi-Spatial Life.

From a Ninth to Eleventh Rank, every step involves the evolution of Multi-Spatial Life towards Temporal Life.

Until reaching the Twelfth Rank.

A Twelfth Rank Ultimate is already barely considered a half-formed Temporal Life.

They occupy the past and present, meandering on the ‘shores’ of the River of Time.

Yet, even Ultimate Existences still aspire, and that is to transform into a perfect Temporal Life.

Simply put, the goal of a Twelfth Rank Ultimate is to attempt to occupy the future.

Only a life that occupies the past, present, and future simultaneously qualifies as a Perfect Time Being.

It is said that a Perfect Time Being can see the infinite future at a glance and return to the ancient past.

Theoretically, as long as a Perfect Time Being so wishes, they could alter the course of history and shape the future into the vision they desire.

However.

Thus far, Lin Yuan has not heard of any existing Perfect Time Being.

Even Xuanhuang and the Moyu Tower Master do not qualify as Perfect Time Beings; they are merely significantly stronger than most Twelfth Rank Ultimates.

“The Chaos Void holds great opportunities, but sadly, we, creatures of the universe, even at Twelfth Rank, cannot leave,” the Xia Qin Supreme Being said, seemingly recalling something, and sighed.

“Unable to leave?”

Lin Yuan looked puzzled.

The Eternal Spatial Rift is right there.

Why can’t they leave?

“The universe has a will, and beings like us at the Twelfth Rank, who have absorbed so much cosmic energy, would inevitably face the universe’s will fighting fiercely to prevent us from escaping to the Chaos Void, once we break free from the universe,” the Xia Qin Supreme Being explained.

“I see.”

Lin Yuan suddenly understood.

“Thus, if we wish to venture into the Chaos Void, we can only wait until this Cosmic Era ends and everything is destroyed, only then might there be a chance,” the Xia Qin Supreme Being’s voice wavered subtly.

Obviously.

The matter was not as simple as he had stated.

The end of the Cosmic Era, the collapse of everything, Supreme Beings only survive if they endure past it, fully freeing themselves from cosmic restrictions.

If they do not endure, they naturally perish with the cosmos.

However, after the destruction of the universe, there will be rebirth, a capability Supreme Beings do not possess.

A Supreme Being, along with the universe, ends, and all their essence transforms into the most chaotic energy to support the birth of a new Cosmic Era.

Typically, among ten Twelfth Rank Ultimates, at most only half can survive the end of a Cosmic Epoch.

Only those Twelfth Rank Ultimates who endure the end of a Cosmic Epoch have the confidence to venture into the Chaos Void.

…

Upon leaving Xia Qin Supreme Being’s personal world,

Lin Yuan’s mind slightly fluctuated.

This time, from the mouth of Xia Qin Supreme Being, he learned much higher-level information.

Such as the nine dangerous places of the Chaos Void?

And the restrictions on Supreme Beings within the universe?

“All this is still too far from me.”

Lin Yuan pondered for a while, then stopped thinking about it.

He’s currently only Tenth Rank, far from reaching Twelfth Rank.

And the end of the Cosmic Epoch?

According to Xia Qin Supreme Being’s estimation, from the birth of the universe to now, only one-tenth of a Cosmic Epoch has passed.

That means, until the end of the Cosmic Epoch, there are still nine-tenths of a Cosmic Epoch remaining, which in years, is countless quintillions.

Lin Yuan, thus far, has spent less than two hundred years in the Main Universe.

…

Meanwhile,

Outside the universe where Lin Yuan resided,

Amidst the grayish Chaos Void,

A piece of ‘white paper’ was rapidly moving in a certain direction.

If one observed carefully, they would realize that this ‘white paper’ seemed not to possess the concept of ‘thickness,’ having only length and width.

Within the ‘white paper,’ fog swirled, subtly encompassing a vast world.

This entire piece of ‘white paper,’ akin to a scroll of painting, was graceful yet mysterious.

Yet, what was strange—

Wherever the ‘white paper’ passed, the space of the Chaos Void subtly began to collapse, rapidly losing the concept of spatial thickness, and even time became abnormally narrow, as if it suddenly reduced from three dimensions to two.

Swoosh.

In a blink of an eye.

That ‘white paper’ disappeared into the dense chaotic currents.
